notes: ACCESS: tier (a) direct HTTP (curl_cffi, impersonate=chrome) for robots.txt and sitemap.xml on www.shopthenovogratz.com (the live Wix store; thenovogratz.com serves the same Wix site). robots.txt is 'User-agent: * / Allow: /' (no anthropic-ai/ClaudeBot disallow), so all tiers permitted. Static category-page HTML is a Wix pre-render shell with no real product totals (the CSS var --gallery_productsCount is a fixed page-size of 16 on every page, not an actual count), so escalated to tier (b) Playwright headless Chromium to read the rendered DOM, global mega-menu nav, and exhaustively paginate via 'Load More'. No blocks encountered at either tier; tier (c) Claude-in-Chrome was not needed. TREE: union of store-categories-sitemap.xml (29 category slugs) + the site's global mega-menu (identical across pages): Furniture > Sofas+Futons, Beds, Fireplaces, Seating, Dining Tables+Sets, Coffee+End Tables, Dressers+Consoles, Desks+Bookshelves, Storage Lockers; Rugs (slug 'textiles') > Indoor/Outdoor Rugs, Indoor Rugs; Lighting > Table Lamps, Floor Lamps, Sconces, Pendants, Flush Mounts, Outdoor Lights; Decor (slug 'decor-gifts') > Wallpaper; Outdoor Furniture > Outdoor Conversation Sets, Outdoor Seating, Outdoor Dining. Each leaf page's rendered title/h1 was confirmed to match the requested slug. Sitemap also listed a 'dining' category absent from the nav; checked directly - contains only furniture (chairs, table+bench sets), no textile/storage relevance, not recorded. QTY: exhaustive pagination count - loaded each qualifying leaf category headless, clicked 'Load More' repeatedly until the button no longer appeared, then counted unique /product-page/ hrefs in the rendered DOM (re-run twice, same result both times). EXCLUDED FROM STORAGE: 'Storage Lockers' shows 'No products here yet...' (0 products) AND is nested inside the 'Furniture' mega-menu group alongside Sofas/Beds/Dining Tables/Dressers/Desks - the site's own hierarchy places it under Furniture, not a Storage/Organization section, so per storage.md Sec21 (explicit Furniture placement -> prefer Furniture) it is excluded here; it is in-scope for the already-validated Furniture.xlsx instead. EXCLUDED FROM TEXTILE: 'Wallpaper' (under Decor) is a peel-and-stick wall covering, not a fabric/textile product per textile.md - excluded. All other mega-menu nodes (Furniture subcats, Lighting subcats, Outdoor Furniture subcats, Decor's rug/lamp duplicates) are Furniture/Lighting, out of scope for this task, not recorded. The Rugs parent ('Shop All' -> /category/textiles) was not recorded per the parent-category-URL rule since 2 valid subcategories exist under it. No candidate node qualified for both Textile and Storage.
